comments.body:
Maybe not completely matching, but I did my PhD in Trento,Italy (physics) and now doing my first postdoc in ETH (quantum chemistry)


From what I have seen, the PhDs come from all sorts of masters.


UvA is a top university in Europe specially on HEP and theory in general (I'm not up to date though, I was interested back when I was finding masters, 8 years ago) so there'd be no problem if you choose to go that route


I merely suggest you try now to care about which program gives you more and deeper exposure to different areas of physics, since you seem undecided on the research topic. Then, when the time comes, don't worry, you will have a good chance of finding what you will be looking for.
comments.author: cwormer
